rubricName: Architectural Alignment — Billing-Cycle (StreamPlex) Premium Upgrade Demo

evalCriteria.prompt: The diff must not modify any file under `src/backend/`, and must not add any new `fetch(`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `axios` or other HTTP call, nor any new request URL, in `src/frontend/`. Score 0 if either occurs.

evalCriteria.metric: Single Premium data source and rendering path
evalCriteria.prompt: In the diff, Premium values ("$25/month", "4K Ultra HD + HDR", "Can watch on 4 devices at once", "Can download on 6 devices", "Dolby Atmos (select titles)") appear only inside one constant object, never as JSX literals. No second, Premium-only copy of the plan-card, usage-card or perks markup is added. Score 0 if Premium values are hardcoded in markup or the markup is duplicated for Premium.

evalCriteria.metric: Upgrade lives in component state only
evalCriteria.prompt: The diff must not write plan or upgrade state to `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `document.cookie` or IndexedDB, must not add it to `AuthContext` or another context or global store, and must not send it to the server. Score 0 if any of these occurs.
The diff must not add `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, `innerHTML`, `outerHTML` or `insertAdjacentHTML` anywhere under `src/frontend/`. Score 0 on any occurrence.

Any changed fetch chain in `Billing.jsx` must have a rejection handler (`.catch` or try/catch around `await`), and must check `response.ok` (or the status) before calling the data setter. No status code, response body or error message may be rendered to the user. Score 0 if the changed fetch lacks either guard or displays error internals.

Any test library (vitest, @testing-library/*, jsdom) added in the diff must appear under `devDependencies`, never `dependencies`. A diff that changes `src/frontend/package.json` dependencies must also include `src/frontend/package-lock.json`. Score 0 if a test library lands in `dependencies` or the lock file is missing from such a diff.
